output.findings:
The base model of the Google Pixel 10 starts at a price of $799, keeping the same launch price tier as its predecessor, the Pixel 9.

Customer and editorial reviews for the Google Pixel 10 are generally positive, receiving an expert rating of around 8.2 out of 10 from tech review aggregation (such as 91mobiles) and a solid 'Bang for the Buck' and performance score of 4 out of 5 in reviews like Mashable.

Like standard Google Pixel hardware releases, the Google Pixel 10 comes with a standard one-year limited manufacturer warranty covering defects in parts and labor for the original purchaser, with optional extended protection plans like Pixel Care available for accidental damage.
